categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in manufacturing precision plastic injection molded parts and modules for automotive components, sanitary home appliances, and office equipment. Key products include EPB electronic parking brake systems, electric power steering components, automotive body parts, and smart toilet modules. The group also extends into electric vehicle motor-related plastic components and medical device parts through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages over 60 years of expertise in precision plastic injection molding, including insert molding and plastic gear module technology. It is transitioning from horizontal to vertical injection molding machines and is actively implementing factory automation to enhance production efficiency and quality. The firm also integrates mold design, manufacturing, and assembly processes to meet high-precision and complex product demands.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are Tier 1 Japanese automotive parts suppliers, with end markets including major Japanese automakers such as Toyota. Other markets served include sanitary home appliance manufacturers (notably smart toilets and air conditioners) and office equipment producers. The company targets OEMs in automotive, residential appliances, and office equipment sectors, with a growing focus on electric vehicles and smart home products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Asia, with key production and R&D facilities in Japan (including a new factory in Nagoya), China, Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand, and Hong Kong. Sales are predominantly in Asia, accounting for over 99% of revenue, with minor sales in the Americas and other regions. The company also invests in the U.S. through strategic partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company functions primarily as a midstream manufacturer in the supply chain, producing critical plastic and metal-plastic hybrid components for automotive and home appliance OEMs. It sources raw plastic resins upstream and supplies finished parts and modules downstream to Tier 1 suppliers and OEMs, integrating vertically through mold design and assembly capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding capacity and R&D in electric vehicle components, especially next-generation EPB systems, and developing new automotive electronic modules. The company emphasizes lightweight, automated, and electronic component development aligned with global automotive electrification trends. It also invests in robotics and smart home appliance innovations, leveraging group resources and partnerships to enhance integrated solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of precision plastic and assembled modules to OEM customers in automotive, home appliance, and office equipment industries. The company employs a profit-sharing sales model with customers and pursues order-based manufacturing contracts. It also benefits from licensing and investment returns from subsidiaries and strategic ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the high-precision automotive parts OEM manufacturing sector, focusing on Japanese Tier 1 suppliers. It holds a niche position with a strong reputation for quality and long-term partnerships, especially with Toyota. Its competitors include other precision plastic and automotive parts manufacturers, but the company differentiates through vertical integration, automation, and specialized EV component development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.66 billion and a net profit of NT$191.7 million, achieving record profitability since listing. It has shown steady revenue growth and improved profitability margins, with a robust financial structure supported by capital increases and convertible bonds. The company maintains a stable cash flow and plans continued investment in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-precision, high-quality plastic injection molded components with integrated mold design and assembly services, enabling it to meet stringent automotive and appliance industry standards. Its long-standing expertise, vertical integration, and automation capabilities allow cost-effective production of complex parts, including lightweight plastic alternatives to metal components. The firm’s close collaboration with customers and focus on EV and smart appliance markets provide competitive differentiation.
